comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: From slot 1's round-1 fixes: background-only rows are cheap on their own - the formatter drops a row with no text at the row level (formatter.zig:1180, hasTextAny); a sibling default-off option counting a styled cell as content, plus the same predicate in the patch's trailing-blank-rows count, is about six lines. OSC 8 on existing text is not cheap: VT output writes no hyperlinks at all (the hyperlink block is HTML-only), so it is ~30-40 lines across both paths of the core content loop, the file most likely to conflict on re-pin. Per-cell DECSCA is similar to links. The kitty stack and DECSC-saved cursor stay unreadable. Round 1 also fixed a style bleed across gaps behind formatter.Options.unstyled_blanks (default off, on only in the patched screen formatter).

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Known gap (MIP-3 section 5, pinned in the corpus): a pane's replay states only the active screen's cursor shape. A pane attached while a full-screen program such as vim runs shows the default shape after the program exits, until the next prompt sets it again. libghostty-vt does not expose the other screen's shape cheaply.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the replay spike (a_2XJ1ffNcD, round 1). The replay (MIP-3 section 5) pins five known gaps as exact differences in corpus/conformance/replay.json: OSC 8 links on text already written, per-cell DECSCA protection, a row painted with a background and no text, the kitty keyboard stack beneath its current flags, and a DECSC-saved cursor. The first three need a change to the formatter's existing output, which the permanent libghostty patch deliberately does not make (it only adds C API); doing it additively means a new formatter option that touches formatter.zig's content loop, a bigger carry on every re-pin. The last two are not readable through the C API at all. Also found: mouse tracking modes replay in ascending order, so a program that enabled 1002 then 1000 comes back in 1002. Links in replayed scrollback are the one a person will notice. Open: which, if any, are worth the larger patch.
title: Replay gaps: links, DECSCA and background-only rows do not survive an attach
